name: dispatch
title: Dispatch
owns: Session launch and control; Fleet provisioning and the workspace, project and clone registry, including each home's identity record, which every package of the same home reads through the contract library; effective policy; the native quota, context and usage readers; reservations; scheduled-job records; steering and lifecycle control; continuity.

commands.name: hive-dispatch
commands.purpose: Launch intent and receipt, the task execution record, runtime ownership and capacity reservation.

commands.name: hive-fleet
commands.purpose: The workspace charter, the parent channel and the registered home, workspace, project and clone identities.

commands.name: hive-session-start
commands.purpose: The home lock, the startup digest and bounded reconciliation at session start.

commands.name: hive-policy
commands.purpose: Role and profile selection with its rule digest, resource evidence and permitted fallbacks.

commands.name: hive-context
commands.purpose: Context and capacity observations and checkpoint readiness.

commands.name: hive-park
commands.purpose: Parking owned work at a safe checkpoint or gate, with its custody and resume authority.

commands.name: hive-resume
commands.purpose: Resuming parked work once, after fresh evidence, policy and authority are rechecked.

commands.name: hive-send
commands.purpose: Durable steering messages, their delivery acceptance and their acknowledgment.

commands.name: hive-control
commands.purpose: Verified lifecycle operations on an exact session generation.

commands.name: hive-stow
commands.purpose: Saving unrecorded decisions, open work and handover facts, and checkpointing active operations.

commands.name: hive-recover
commands.purpose: Recovery from a checkpoint, reusing existing work.

commands.name: hive-sync
commands.purpose: Guarded synchronization of a project copy.

commands.name: hive-retire
commands.purpose: The retirement queue: releasing owned execution resources once every applicable receipt is in.

receipt_kinds.asserts: A private home was given its identity record.
A workspace was registered with the Fleet home that owns it.
A project was registered under one workspace.
A physical clone was bound to one project.
One input was placed durably in a session's canonical input sequence.

test_scope: Admission, profile resolution, observation provenance, exact-target recovery and scheduled-job transitions from filing through due, run, hold and retirement.
